speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. To begin our assessment of your weakness and fatigue, can you tell me how long you have been experiencing these symptoms and if they worsen with activity?

speaker: Patient
text: 33-year-old woman. The patient reports feeling extremely fatigued and weak, especially towards the end of the day, to the point of difficulty in self-care. She mentions experiencing these symptoms currently. The patient has been traveling, hiking, and camping recently and notes having had multiple illnesses in the recent past.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that information. Your recent travel and camping history raise concerns for tick-borne illnesses or malaria; have you noticed any fever, chills, or a rash since returning? REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count, Ferritin, TSH.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Weakness and fatigue. I also have Mild diplopia. To keep my notes clear, please give only one final answer and keep it to a single direct conclusion.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Myasthenia Gravis. The combination of progressive weakness and fatigue worsening with activity, alongside the recent onset of mild diplopia (double vision), strongly points to an autoimmune neuromuscular junction disorder. REQUEST IMAGES: Chest_CT_to_rule_out_thymoma.
